title: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills: four rules against agent overbuilding
friendlyTitle: A short rules file for stopping a coding agent from overbuilding
summary: This guidelines file gained 702 stars today on GitHub's daily trending list, and now has about 224,400. It is one MIT-licensed CLAUDE.md, also wired for Cursor, written from Andrej Karpathy's notes on coding-agent failure: silent assumptions, bloated abstractions, and edits to code the task did not touch.
friendlySummary: This guidelines file gained 702 stars today on GitHub's daily trending list, and now has about 224,400. It is one free CLAUDE.md file, also set up for Cursor. It is written from Andrej Karpathy's notes on how coding agents fail: they guess instead of asking, they build more than you asked for, and they edit code the task did not touch.
whyItMatters: Drop the file into a project, or install the Claude Code plugin, when you want the agent to state assumptions, keep the change small, and stop when a test says the job is done. The repo's own tradeoff is explicit: the rules favour caution over speed, so skip them for a one-line fix. The README's curl example still points at an older GitHub path. Use this repository, not that URL.
